page.layout: Two medallion portraits side by side at the top, with their legends (engraving, not text); below them one column of running text, full width; no margin notes. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top left.

main_text.p: HIERONYMVS Cardanus, Medicus Mediolanensis subtilissimus, multa scripsit tam acute & diligenter, vt merito ab omnibus literatis, ob eius summum ingenium exactamque plurimarum rerum cognitionem, passim existimetur. Scripsit Arith-meticam absolutissimam: Practicam Arithmeticae & mesuran-di singularem, Artis magnae, siue de regulis algebraicis, librum vnū, qui & totius operis de Arithmetica, quod opus perfectum inscripsit, est in ordine, decimus: de Sapientia libros quinque: de consolatione libros tres, ab authore recognitos: de immor-talitate animae, librū excusum à Gryphio, Lugduni anno Do-mini 1545. in 8. chartis 20. Contradicentium medicorū librum, continentem contradictiones 1081. de malo recentium medi-corum medendi vsu, libellum, 100. errores illorum, continen-tem: & infinitos alios, quos hæc pagina non potest capere. Flo-ruit anno salutis 1544.

IVLIVS Cæsar Scaliger, Iosephi Scaligeri frater, vir magni nominis hic laudandus venit, qui de causis linguę Latinę 13. lib. scripsit: de comicis dimensionibus: commentarios in Hippocratis librum de somniis, adiecto etiam textu ab eodem converso: commentarios in libros duos, qui inscribuntur de plantis, Ari-stotele autore: plurima acutè & solidè confutauit ab Hierony-mo Cardano scripta, in libris de subtilitate: composuit de Poë-tica libros sex, varia eruditione refertos: commentarios in Theo-phrasti libros de plantis: verae Alchimiae artisque metallicae ci-tra ænigmata doctrinam certumque modum scripsit: de sapientia & beatitudine libros 8. quos Epidormides inscripsit: unde & plurimis aliis frugiferis commentationibus magnam gloriam est assecutus. Floruit tempore Cardani.

page.notes: The two legends are engraved around the medallions; the right medallion's legend reads "Q. MED." on the left and "C. SCALIGERVS" on the right. The full stop after "Cardani" is a faint mark and may be a comma. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens. No damage or illegible words.
